item: 7. Peninsula South U2 (Guohua) status and phases
farm: Shandong Bandaonan U2 (Guohua) Offshore wind farm
proposal: (lead) if accepted: fix('CHN', 'Shandong Bandaonan U2 (Guohua) Offshore wind farm', G, …, 'https://www.ceic.com/gjnyjtww/chnjcxw/202509/92abff82688f4920bbcb5f96176c7f2b.shtml', st=0, year=2024, turbine='71x Envision EN226-8.5')
note_zh: U2 是國家能源集團國華投資的場址（不是國家電投）：603.5 MW、71 部遠景 EN226-8.5 MW，一期 306 MW（36 部）、二期 297.5 MW（35 部）。正反證據：(1) 2024-10-26 國家電投 U1 二期併網時，中國電器工業協會等寫「山東半島南 U 場址海上風電項目（150 萬千瓦，含 U2 60 萬千瓦）實現全容量併網」；(2) 國家能源集團 2025-09-02：U2 60 萬千瓦「安裝 71 台」、2025-08-28 全容量登記 CCER；但 (3) 中證鵬元 2025-06 評級報告把 U2 一期、二期都列在「截至 2024 年末公司主要在建、擬建項目」（2025 年各只剩 0.74、0.63 億元投資）；(4) 山東 2025 年海洋強省重點項目名單仍有 U2 二期。查不到 U2 自己的全容量併網日期，維持線索；若主對話接受 U 場址整體併網的說法，可改營運中 2024 年。
note_en: U2 is CHN Energy Guohua’s site (not SPIC): 603.5 MW, 71 Envision EN226-8.5 MW, phase 1 306 MW (36 units), phase 2 297.5 MW (35). For: (1) when SPIC’s U1 phase 2 connected on 26 Oct 2024, CEEIA and others wrote that “the Peninsula South U-site project (1,500 MW incl. U2’s 600 MW) reached full capacity”; (2) CHN Energy, 2 Sept 2025: U2 600 MW “has 71 turbines installed” and was registered for its full capacity under CCER on 28 Aug 2025. Against: (3) the June 2025 CSCI Pengyuan rating report lists U2 phases 1 and 2 among the company’s “projects under construction or planned at end-2024” (only CNY 74 m and 63 m left for 2025); (4) Shandong’s 2025 marine key-project list still includes U2 phase 2. No U2-specific full-connection date found, so a lead; if the main session accepts the U-site statement, set operating 2024.
why: No U2-specific grid-connection report; ceic/cpnn give only CCER registration; carbontree.com.cn (U2 phase-1 emission-reduction notice) fails TLS verification; cpnn.com.cn connection drops.

item: 11. Datang Danzhou CZ3 site 2 full connection?
note_zh: 到 2026-10-07 仍查不到二場址任何機組或全容量併網的報導；最新官方紀錄是洋浦海事局 2026-10-02 為二場址「海上風機和基礎施工標段二」增加作業船舶的通告，仍在海上施工。維持興建中，年底再查。
note_en: As of 7 Oct 2026 there is still no report of any site-2 unit or of full connection; the latest official record is the Yangpu MSA notice of 2 Oct 2026 adding a vessel to site 2’s “turbine and foundation lot 2”, i.e. still under offshore construction. Keep under construction; check again at year end.
why: No grid-connection news after the Dec 2025 start; target is end-2026.
